data.content_ref: inline:The target asserts a substantive abstraction relation (thermos physics → generic radiation-trapping framework) but the refutation condition is malformed: it hinges on 'sky view factor does not correlate with nocturnal UHI intensity after controlling for thermal mass' AND 'geometric obstruction is the dominant radiative variable'. If sky-view-factor correlation fails after controlling for thermal mass, that means thermal mass (not geometric obstruction) is dominant, so both disjuncts cannot be false simultaneously. This conjunction structure makes the abstraction unfalsifiable rather than refuted by any single empirical outcome.
